name: pong-ultimate-skills
description: Pong's Claude Code workflow. pong for any software; painter for frontend and UI work (includes pong).

plugins.name: pong
plugins.description: For any software (backend, CLI, libraries, services): plan a project (grill → PRD → spec → tickets), then build each ticket with subagents (Opus plans, Sonnet implements, Opus reviews). Guard and format hooks for Python and TypeScript.

plugins.name: painter
plugins.description: For frontend and UI work: everything in pong (installed automatically) plus design taste, UI reference images, design direction, critique and polish.
